sloka: परितुष्टो अस्मि भद्रम् ते राजपुत्र महायशः ।प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो ददामि अस्त्राणि सर्वशः ॥१-२७-२॥
transliteration: parituṣṭo asmi bhadram te rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ ।prītyā paramayā yukto dadāmi astrāṇi sarvaśaḥ ॥1-27-2॥

translations.english: "O prince of great renown, I am extremely pleased. May you prosper Out of great love and affection for you I shall make over all the weapons.
